figurative_meaning_en: running around; bustling about; hurrying; busyness
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমার আর দৌড়ঝাঁপ করার বয়স নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: I'm too old for all this running around.
Everyone is bustling about for the project.
note: This is a compound of synonymous words (একার্থক সহচর শব্দদ্বয়) evoking physical exertion in daily Bengali life.
